```{r, echo=F}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(FLCore)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size=16))
```

# read bias-corrected future temperature data

We read the bias-corrected future temperature data generated in the previous markdown (`2_code_biascorrection_env`)

```{r}
# read data 

temp.dat <- readRDS(file="sst_projection.RDS")
summary(temp.dat)

# first year of the FLBEIA simulations

yr.first <- 2022

# create centered year variable

temp.dat$year.cent <- temp.dat$year - yr.first

# number of simulations

nit <- 1000

```

# Include uncertainty

Given that we only have one time series for each of the scenarios, we simulate the uncertainty around each of the time-series as a linear trend + AR(1)

Note that if we have an AR(1) process: 

$$y_{t}=b y_{t-1} + u_t$$
where $u_t \sim N(0, \sigma^2)$, then:

$$Var(y_t)=b^2 Var(y_{t-1}) + Var(u_t)$$
And it follows that: 

$$Var(y_t)=\frac{\sigma^2}{1-b^2}$$


## POLCOMS-ERSEM RCP 8.5

2006-2099

```{r}

# index identifying non-NA values
idx <- which(!is.na(temp.dat$pe85.qmap))

# linear trend
# we use the alternative parameterization of year so that the reference year is yr.first

m0 <- lm(pe85.qmap ~ year.cent, data=temp.dat[idx, ])
summary(m0)
plot(m0)
plot(acf(resid(m0)))
plot(pacf(resid(m0)))

# using year we get the same results

m0b <- lm(pe85.qmap ~ year, data=temp.dat[idx, ])
coef(m0b)

# linear trend + AR(1)
# using the alternative parameterization

m1 <- arima(temp.dat$pe85.qmap[idx], order=c(1,0,0), xreg=temp.dat$year.cent[idx])
print(m1)

# linear trend + AR(1)
# using year we get the same results

m1b <- arima(temp.dat$pe85.qmap[idx], order=c(1,0,0), xreg=temp.dat$year[idx])
print(m1b)

# simulate (1 iteration) from linear trend + AR(1)

pred.ar1 <- arima.sim(model=list(order = c(1,0,0), ar = c(coef(m1)["ar1"])), sd=sqrt(m1$sigma2), n=nrow(temp.dat[idx,]))

pred.lm <- coef(m1)["intercept"] + coef(m1)["temp.dat$year.cent[idx]"] * temp.dat$year.cent[idx]

pred <- pred.lm + pred.ar1

plot(temp.dat$year[idx], pred, type="l", xlab="", ylab="", main="POLCOMS-ERSEM RCP 8.5")
lines(temp.dat$year[idx], temp.dat$pe85.qmap[idx], col=2)
abline( coef(m0b), col=4)
abline(coef(m1b)[c("intercept", "temp.dat$year[idx]")], col=3)

# simulate (1000 iterations) from linear trend + AR(1)

set.seed(444)

tmp <- sapply(1:nit, function(x) {
  pred.ar1 <- arima.sim(model=list(order = c(1,0,0), ar = c(coef(m1)["ar1"])),
                                   sd=sqrt(m1$sigma2), n=nrow(temp.dat[idx,]))
  pred.lm <- coef(m1)["intercept"] + coef(m1)["temp.dat$year.cent[idx]"] * temp.dat$year.cent[idx]
  pred <- pred.lm + pred.ar1
  pred
  }
)

# transform to FLQuant
pred.temp.pe85.quant <- as.FLQuant(tmp, dim=c(1, nrow(temp.dat[idx,]),1,1,1,nit))
dimnames(pred.temp.pe85.quant)$year <- temp.dat$year[idx]
plot(pred.temp.pe85.quant)

as.data.frame(pred.temp.pe85.quant) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()

# simulate (1000 iterations) from AR(1) NO Climate change

set.seed(444)

tmp <- sapply(1:nit, function(x) {
  pred.ar1 <- arima.sim(model=list(order = c(1,0,0), ar = c(coef(m1)["ar1"])),
                                   sd=sqrt(m1$sigma2), n=nrow(temp.dat[idx,]))
  pred.lm <- coef(m1)["intercept"] 
  pred <- pred.lm + pred.ar1
  pred
  }
)

# transform to FLQuant
pred.temp.pe85.nocc.quant <- as.FLQuant(tmp, dim=c(1, nrow(temp.dat[idx,]),1,1,1,nit))
dimnames(pred.temp.pe85.nocc.quant)$year <- temp.dat$year[idx]
plot(pred.temp.pe85.nocc.quant)

as.data.frame(pred.temp.pe85.nocc.quant) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()

```

# Save dataset

```{r, eval=T}
saveRDS(pred.temp.pe85.quant, file="results/temp_pe85_projection_1000it.RDS")
saveRDS(pred.temp.pe85.nocc.quant, file="results/temp_pe85_nocc_projection_1000it.RDS")
saveRDS(pred.temp.pe45.quant, file="results/temp_pe45_projection_1000it.RDS")

saveRDS(pred.temp.nm85.nocc.quant, file="results/temp_nm85_nocc_projection_1000it.RDS")
```
